name: Loop and fleet dashboard components
status_reason: Source review of both component files at revision f248664d. The portal container scope file is absent from the discovery index and FleetOverview's render tail past line 600 was not read (evidence budget), so composition and runtime behavior are unverified.; verified against sources 2026-09-14 (map author pass)
description: Presentational MUI components in packages/web-components: CFNLoopDashboard (5-loop stepper, confidence cards, consensus metrics, activity timeline) and FleetOverview (agent cards with filter/sort/pagination, WebSocket real-time merge). Portal composition unverified.
purpose: Two reusable, props-only React components in packages/web-components visualize loop and fleet state. CFNLoopDashboard.tsx renders CFN Loop state from one required loopState prop: four metric cards (overall confidence, completed/total loops, average loop confidence computed by dividing summed confidence over loops that have one, recent activity count), a phase progress bar, a vertical MUI Stepper over five hardcoded loopStepConfigs (Loop 0 Epic/Sprint, Loop 1 Phase Execution, Loop 2 Validation consensus >=0.90, Loop 3 Implementation swarm >=0.75, Loop 4 Product Owner GOAP gate) with activeStep = loopState.currentPhase.currentLoop, per-loop status/confidence chips, consensus validator scores behind showDetailedMetrics, an optional productOwnerDecision panel (decision chip colored via PROCEED=success/DEFER=warning/ESCALATE=error, reasoning, confidence, next steps), and an @mui/lab Timeline of recentActivity sliced to maxActivities (default 10) where clicking an activity calls onAgentSelect(agentId). FleetOverview.tsx renders fleet state from an agents array: one AgentCardComponent per agent (status chip + icon, connection indicator, progress and health bars, CPU/memory/tokens/efficiency metrics, two most recent errors as ErrorBadge, last-activity and ETA footer), client-side filtering (status, connectionStatus, swarmId, minHealth, errorsOnly, free-text search) plus sorting (name/status/created/lastActivity/efficiency) and optional pagination with page clamped to totalPages, fleet statistics from calculateStatistics (status counts, avgHealth, avgEfficiency, totalTokens, totalTasks; returns zeroed stats when agents is empty), and real-time updates: when enableRealTime and websocketUrl are both set it opens a WebSocket whose 'agent-update' messages are merged over the props agents via a Map spread; a malformed message is caught, logged with console.error, and the last rendered state is kept. Both components fetch nothing themselves: data arrives via props and refresh happens only when the host passes onRefresh (CFNLoopDashboard polls every refreshInterval; FleetOverview when autoRefresh, default interval 5000ms), so the portal composes them by supplying loopState/agents plus refresh and select callbacks. Failure/empty paths inside FleetOverview are styled LoadingOverlay/ErrorBadge/EmptyState blocks driven by loading/error props and the empty-agents case. To add a loop step, edit loopStepConfigs; the stepper, chips, and step content follow automatically. The portal half of the question could not be answered from evidence: packages/web-portal/src/client/containers/CFNLoopDashboardContainer.tsx is not in the discovery index.

sources.claim: Imports MUI Stepper/Step/StepLabel/StepContent, Chip, @mui/lab Timeline primitives and a styles module; loopStepConfigs hardcodes the five loop steps the dashboard renders (Loop 0 Epic/Sprint 'Multi-phase orchestration', Loop 1 Phase Execution, Loop 2 Validation 'Consensus validation (>=0.90)', Loop 3 Implementation 'Primary swarm (>=0.75)', Loop 4 Product Owner 'GOAP decision gate'), each with an icon. Helpers: getConfidenceColor returns success at >= threshold, warning at >= 0.8x threshold, else error; getStatusIcon maps completed/failed/blocked/in-progress to CheckCircle/Error/Warning/Hourglass with a disabled Hourglass default; getDecisionColor maps PROCEED/DEFER/ESCALATE to success/warning/error.

The component is presentational and props-driven: required loopState plus onAgentSelect, showDetailedMetrics (default false), maxActivities (default 10), refreshInterval, onRefresh, className, data-testid default 'cfn-loop-dashboard'. No fetching: the useEffect only setInterval-calls the host's onRefresh when both refreshInterval and onRefresh are provided. Derived metrics memo computes completedLoops (status==='completed'), progressPercent, and avgConfidence as sum of confidence values divided by the count of loops that have a confidence. Renders header (objective, swarmId, phase chip, refresh button) and four ConfidenceCards: overall confidence, loops completed x/y, avg loop confidence, agent activity count, all colored through getConfidenceColor with a 0.75 threshold.

The CFN Loop Stepper is a vertical MUI Stepper with activeStep = loopState.currentPhase.currentLoop; each of the five loopStepConfigs renders a Step whose completion/error comes from the matching loopState.loops entry (matched by loopType), with optional status and confidence-percent Chips. Only the active step gets StepContent, and the consensus validator list (agentId, recommendation count, score colored against the consensus threshold, default 0.75) is additionally gated behind showDetailedMetrics; retryCount/maxRetries and duration metrics render when retryCount is defined.

The tail of the file: an optional productOwnerDecision section (decision chip via getDecisionColor, reasoning text, decision-confidence and next-steps-count metric boxes, and a next-steps list with arrow icons) and the Recent Agent Activity @mui/lab Timeline mapping recentActivity (sliced by maxActivities) to TimelineItems with success/failure-colored dots, agent avatar, name:action title, agentType chip, and an optional TrendingUp confidence chip; clicking an activity item calls onAgentSelect(activity.agentId). The component ends here with a default export at line 469.

FleetOverview is a 'Comprehensive fleet management dashboard with grid/list views, pagination, and real-time updates' built from MUI controls (Select, TextField, Pagination, ToggleButtonGroup, CircularProgress, Alert) and a styled-component vocabulary imported from FleetOverview.styles: FleetContainer, FleetHeader, FilterControls, StatisticsGrid, StatCard, GridView, ListView, AgentCard(+Header/Info/Avatar/Footer), StatusChip, ConnectionIndicator, ProgressBar/ProgressFill, MetricsGrid, MetricItem, ErrorBadge, EmptyState, PaginationContainer, LoadingOverlay. Local formatters: formatDuration (h/m/s), formatBytes (B..GB), formatTimeSince ('Just now', 'Nm/Nh/Nd ago').

getProgressSeverity colors bars success >=80, warning >=50, else error; getStatusIcon maps active/busy to PlayArrow, paused Pause, error Error, terminated Stop, idle CheckCircle, default Timer. calculateStatistics walks the agents array into a FleetStatistics (counts by status active/idle/paused/error/terminated/offline, avgHealth, avgEfficiency, totalTokens, totalTasks) and returns the zeroed object immediately when agents.length === 0. AgentCardComponent renders avatar (or first 2 chars of name), name/type/activity, StatusChip with icon, connection indicator, and progress bar when agent.progress > 0.

AgentCard tail: health bar, MetricsGrid (CPU percent, memory as formatBytes(memoryUsage) or percent, tokens toLocaleString, efficiency percent), up to two recent errors rendered as ErrorBadge with WarningIcon, and a footer with formatTimeSince(lastActivity) plus an ETA from estimatedCompletion. The FleetOverview component accepts a wide prop surface (agents, selectedAgentId, onAgentSelect, onRefresh, autoRefresh default false, refreshInterval default 5000, filter, sort default name/asc, viewMode default grid, enablePagination default true, pageSize default 12, enableVirtualScrolling default false, showStatistics/showFilters/showSort/showViewToggle, compact, className, websocketUrl, enableRealTime default false, loading, error, onAgentAction) and keeps filter/sort/viewMode/lastUpdated/realTimeData as local state.

Real-time path: a useEffect opens a WebSocket only when enableRealTime && websocketUrl; onmessage JSON.parses inside try/catch, and on a parse error logs console.error and keeps going (last state stays rendered); messages of type 'agent-update' with an id are stored in a realTimeData Map and spread-merged over the props agents in enhancedAgents. filteredAgents applies filter.status, filter.connectionStatus, filter.swarmId, filter.minHealth, filter.errorsOnly (agents with errors) and a case-insensitive search over name/type/activity, then sorts by name/status/created/lastActivity/efficiency with asc/desc direction. Pagination is derived in an effect that clamps page to totalPages (or 1).

paginatedAgents slices filteredAgents by page only when enablePagination && !enableVirtualScrolling; statistics memo recompute on enhancedAgents; autoRefresh effect setInterval-calls onRefresh (and stamps lastUpdated) with cleanup; handleRefresh toggles isRefreshing around the awaited onRefresh. The header renders a status Select (All/idle/active/busy/paused/error/offline; 'all' clears the filter), a search TextField, a sort Select (name/status/created/Activity/efficiency) and a grid/list ToggleButtonGroup.

unknowns: The portal-composition half of the question is unverified: packages/web-portal/src/client/containers/CFNLoopDashboardContainer.tsx is not present in the discovery index (span lookup errors with 'not present in the discovery index'; symbols probes on packages/web-portal, packages/web-portal/src and packages/ all return zero items), so which code mounts CFNLoopDashboard or FleetOverview, where loopState/agents data comes from, and whether the container file exists on disk outside the index is unknown from this run.

FleetOverview.tsx past line 600 was not read (16-call evidence budget exhausted): the final render tail - StatisticsGrid/StatCard rendering, GridView vs ListView mapping of AgentCards, EmptyState/LoadingOverlay/error Alert wiring, the PaginationContainer, and whether enableVirtualScrolling actually virtualizes anything - is unverified.
The sibling .types.ts and .styles.ts files were not read; the shapes of LoopStatus, Agent, AgentStatus, LoopStepConfig and the styled-component implementations are inferred from usage sites only.

No importer of either component was located (relations were not queryable within budget), so 'reusable' rests on the packages/web-components placement and props-only design rather than on found consumers; other visualizers of loop/fleet state elsewhere in the repo are not excluded.
